get.description: Report whether the API is up and can reach the database.

delete.description: Deletes the module with all its topics, assessments, tasks and materials.

get.description:
The module's topics as a nested tree, siblings in position order, each with the
number of material pages linked to it.

schema.title: Response Get Topic Tree Modules  Module Id  Topics Get

delete.description: Deletes the topic and all its subtopics.

get.description:
How far the AI topic map has got: materials analysed of those eligible, the merge,
and whether jobs are waiting for AI rate limits to reset (`waiting_until`).

post.description:
Analyse every eligible material not analysed yet, then merge into the topic tree.

Existing topics are never renamed, moved or deleted; only new topics are added.

get.description: Each eligible material's topic extraction: analysed, failed (with why), or waiting.

schema.title: Response Material Topic States Modules  Module Id  Topic Map Materials Get

post.description:
Find this material's topics again: a new run with a fresh AI call budget.

422 if its topics aren't extracted (AI off, a kind that isn't analysed, or not ready).

delete.description:
Delete every topic still marked AI. Topics the student made or edited stay.

The materials' proposals are kept, so building again re-merges without re-analysing.

post.description: Confirm an AI topic as it is: it becomes the student's, counted as kept.

Fold this topic into ``target_id``: its subtopics, cited pages and page links move
there, then it's deleted. Returns the target. 422 for a topic in another module, the
topic itself, or one of its subtopics.

Delete an AI topic (and its subtopics still marked AI) and remember the names, so a
merge never adds them again. The student's subtopics move up. 422 if it isn't AI.
Confirm every topic still marked AI.

schema.title: Response Dismissed Topics Modules  Module Id  Dismissed Topics Get

post.description: Bring a dismissed topic back (as kept), with its description and cited pages.

get.description:
The pages linked to a topic, grouped by material: cited by the AI, or similar
(with the score).

schema.title: Response Topic Pages Topics  Topic Id  Pages Get

delete.description: Unlink a page from a topic. Remembered: relinking never links it again.

get.description:
Your assessments across all modules, soonest first (undated last).

Repeat ``status`` to keep only those statuses, e.g. ``?status=upcoming``.
The module's assessments, soonest first (undated last).

schema.title: Response List Module Assessments Modules  Module Id  Assessments Get

patch.description: Change the fields sent; ``topic_ids`` replaces the whole set ([] clears it).

delete.description: Deletes the assessment; its tasks are kept, unlinked.

get.description:
Your tasks across all modules, soonest due first (undated last).

Repeat ``status`` to keep only those statuses, e.g. ``?status=todo&status=in_progress``.
The module's tasks, soonest due first (undated last).

schema.title: Response List Module Tasks Modules  Module Id  Tasks Get

patch.description: Setting status to "done" records completed_at; any other status clears it.

post.description:
Open a session with its start event (201).

Resending the same start event returns the existing session (200). Only one
session can be open at a time (409).

get.description: Your open session with its events (to resume the timer after a reload), or null.

schema.title: Response Get Active Session Sessions Active Get

post.description:
Add timer events, in any order. Already-stored ids are skipped if unchanged (409 if not).

The whole log is replayed: an impossible sequence (e.g. resume while active) is a
422 and nothing in the batch is saved.

put.description: Save the end-of-session reflection, replacing any earlier one (ended sessions only).

get.description: A page of the module's sessions: the open one first, then newest first.
Measured study time for the module: all time, and since `week_start` (your local week).

post.description:
Upload one file (at most 50 MB) to the module and queue it for processing.

The same file twice in one module is a 409; a wrong type is a 415.

schema.title: Response List Materials Modules  Module Id  Materials Get

patch.description: Change the title, the kind or whether AI may process it.

delete.description: Delete the material (its file too, unless another of your modules has the same file).

post.description: Queue a failed material for processing again.

get.description: The extracted pages (without their text), in order. Empty until extraction has run.

schema.title: Response List Pages Materials  Material Id  Pages Get

get.description:
The original file, for the viewer. Cached for good (the ETag is its sha256), so an
If-None-Match with that ETag gets a 304. 404 for another user's material or a lost file.

Search the module's materials by meaning and by words (hybrid, reciprocal rank fusion).

Each result is one chunk of one page. `indexed_chunks` is 0 until a material is indexed.

Which AI providers have a key (yes/no only), each role's models, and today's usage.

Usage counts the current user's requests since each provider's daily quota reset.

file.title: File
file.description: PDF, PPTX, DOCX, MD, TXT, PNG or JPG

EventBatch.title: EventBatch
EventBatch.description: Events to add, in any order. Ids already stored are skipped if unchanged.

retrying.title: Retrying
retrying.description: A failed attempt is waiting to be retried (`error` says why it failed).

MaterialTopicStatus.title: MaterialTopicStatus
MaterialTopicStatus.description: Where one eligible material's topic extraction stands (the Materials tab).

ModuleSessionSummary.title: ModuleSessionSummary
ModuleSessionSummary.description: Measured study time for a module (active time only; breaks aren't study time).

PageOut.title: PageOut
PageOut.description: One page's extracted text, as stored.

PageSummary.title: PageSummary
PageSummary.description: A page in the list (no text): for choosing one to open.

SessionDetailOut.title: SessionDetailOut
SessionDetailOut.description: A session with its events in timeline order, for resuming the timer.

SessionPage.title: SessionPage
SessionPage.description: One page of a module's sessions: the open one first, then newest first.

SnippetPart.title: SnippetPart
SnippetPart.description: A run of snippet text; ``highlight`` marks words that matched the query.

TopicMove.title: TopicMove
TopicMove.description: Move a topic under ``parent_id`` (null = top level) at index ``position``.

TopicNodeOut.title: TopicNodeOut
TopicNodeOut.description: A topic with its subtopics, for rendering the tree.

TopicReviewStats.title: TopicReviewStats
TopicReviewStats.description:
What the student did with the AI's topics (decision 0009). Each AI topic counts once,
by the last thing done to it; ``unreviewed`` are those still marked AI.
